spellbook.finance/limitations: A response with alreadyImportedAs means this seller already imported the product and nothing was written. Tell the person the earlier date. Resend with overrideDuplicate true only when they confirm a second physical deck.
The duplicate check runs only when copyCount is 1 and overrideDuplicate is false. Any other call writes every card again, so after a timeout read spellbook_inventory_holdings before a retry.
Error decklist_not_cached means SpellBook has no decklist for that product yet, and nothing was written. Use spellbook_inventory_bin_ensure with each printing instead.
Error not_precon or not_individual_precon means the product is a booster box, a bundle of several decks, or another non-deck product. Nothing was written.

The decklist is the product as printed. A card missing from the physical box is still recorded, so ask the person whether anything was missing and fix counts with spellbook_inventory_bin_ensure afterward.
binAssignments names every bin used and its card count. Tell the person which physical bin each group of cards belongs in.
Copies are stamped with this precon import, the same as the web app, so spellbook_ebay_publish and the ManaPool sync tools accept them.
This tool cannot undo an import. A person deletes it in the SpellBook web app.
Workspace membership is backend-enforced. This writes to the workspace you name and to no other.

On `free_seller_card_cap_exceeded`, the whole import was refused. Recovery scope is workspace; observedAt timestamps the observation, not later state. cap is the allowance. countIsExact applies to activeUnitCount; false means a lower bound. headroom is admission capacity after reservations, clamped at zero. rowsFit counts requested physical units that fit. Inventory reads and order fulfillment remain available. This says nothing about automation or payment. Offer a smaller import or making room.

annotations.title: Add a Commander precon to inventory

description: Add one or more opened Commander precon decks to inventory as individual cards, the same Add Commander deck flow the SpellBook web app runs. The server reads the cached decklist for that TCGplayer product, creates one inventory copy per card at the exact deck printing, assigns bins, and splits the price paid across the cards. Returns the importId, how many copies were written, and the count placed in each bin.

acquisitionDate.description: The date the seller bought the deck, as YYYY-MM-DD. Required.

binPrefix.description: One capital letter that starts the auto-assigned bin codes, e.g. C gives C0001. Required.

copyCount.description: How many identical decks were opened, 1 to 20. Defaults to 1.

oneBinPerDeck.description: True puts each deck in its own fresh bin. Defaults to false, which packs the cards into the rolling bin sequence.

overrideDuplicate.description: True imports the deck even when this seller already imported the same product. Set it only when the person confirms a second physical deck.

paidPriceUsd.description: What the seller paid for ONE deck in USD. Required. Send 0 only when the deck cost nothing. Every copy of the deck is recorded at this price.

tcgProductId.description: Exact TCGplayer product id of the sealed precon deck, from spellbook_sealed_product_search. Required. A product that is not a single Commander or Riftbound precon deck is refused.

workspaceId.description: The workspace to add the cards to, from spellbook_workspaces_list. Required; writes only to this workspace.

name: spellbook_inventory_precon_import
